    length = 0
    i = 1
    while length + i * len(str(i)) < k:
        length += i * len(str(i))
        i += 1
    k -= length
    num = 10**(i-1) + (k - 1) // i
    digit_index = (k - 1) % i
    return str(num)[digit_index]
